notes.title: December Demo Update 2024
notes.content:
Experience a new chapter in The Legend Of Lorosity!!

- Save System is now enabled!
- Shard Magic becomes available!
- Experience chapter 2 in its entirety!

notes.title: March Demo Update 2023
notes.content:
Version 1.001

* Adjusted offense and defense boost functionality. Attack and defense accessories are no longer percentage base and now will increase from a fixed number.

* Fixed soft lock issue when transitioning to another room and a battle encounter is triggered.

* Fixed armor shop displaying incorrect information in empty slots.

If you find any bugs, please report them in the steam discussion thread in the "bugs/glitches" thread.

We appreciate all feedback! If any, post in our "feedback" thread.


Thank you!
